title: Disney's THE LION KING – Great Southern Bank Broadway Season
seo_title: Disney's THE LION KING – Broadway Season Musical
description: Disney's THE LION KING is a stage musical you attend in person, directed by Tony Award-winning Julie Taymor, with music by Elton John and Tim Rice. It won six Tony Awards, including Best Musical, and tells a story of hope and adventure with striking visuals. Recommended for ages 6+, and all patrons, regardless of age, must have a ticket, which should be bought only through HammonsHall.com or MissouriStateTix.com.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
